reader_summary.headline: Magnus Grimeland is the CEO and founder of Antler, one of the world's largest day zero investor.
reader_summary.overview: Magnus Grimeland is the CEO and founder of Antler, one of the world's largest day zero investor. Antler's pre-seed strategy canvasses 27 countries, 1,000 portfolio companies, 8,000+ founders. Magnus founded Antler in 2017 after serving as the co-founder of Zalora, a tech-enable fashion brand in Asia.

key_points.text: Antler's pre-seed strategy canvasses 27 countries, 1,000 portfolio companies, 8,000+ founders.
Our conversation covers Magnus' journey from growing up in rural Norway to developing a global startup platform, characteristics of successful entrepreneurs.
